1232	access on the source other than those it holds; 5 anchors of the value valid; 6 non-escape
1233	(MM-03.3.6) towards the destination's frame, for the anchors of the value and of the usable
1234	places it owns, whose frame changes with it (A5), each frame read after the transfer (B7);
1235	7 no leaf of the source pinned, statically
1236	(`Pinned`, MM-03.3.8) or dynamically (A8); B8 on the effective anchor (C1): for every dependent
1237	usable after the transfer, if its effective anchor moves with the value, or if the dependent
1238	itself moves (the destination, or a place the value owns), the frame of the effective anchor is
1239	the dependent's frame or an ancestor of it, both frames read after the transfer
1240	(`EffAnchorOK`); G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival state, the whole predicate, for every held
1241	authority; J1: the destination has the shape of the source (`SameShape`). O4.3 holds by
1242	construction. -/
1243	def TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
1244	  s.Usable src ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
1245	  s.Usable dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
1246	  HasRight s .modify src ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
1247	  (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst ∧
1248	  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) ∧
1249	  (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, s.Active x) ∧
1250	  (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src,
1251	    NoEscape (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe dst)) ∧
1252	  (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
1253	  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
1254	    ∀ x ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D q,
1255	      (AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x) ∨ q = dst ∨ OwnedWithin s src q) →
1256	      EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) ∧
1257	  AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff s src dst) ∧ SameShape s.P src dst
1258	
1259	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
1260	    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) := by
1261	  unfold TransferPre; infer_instance
1262	
1263	/-- The preconditions of `transfer` other than the shape of the destination (J1): `TransferPre`
1264	without its last clause (`transferPre_iff`). Used to show that a transfer is rejected by the shape
1265	clause alone. -/
1266	def TransferPreBase (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
1267	  s.Usable src ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
1268	  s.Usable dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
1269	  HasRight s .modify src ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
1270	  (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst ∧
1271	  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) ∧
1272	  (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, s.Active x) ∧
1273	  (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src,
1274	    NoEscape (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe dst)) ∧
1275	  (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
1276	  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
1277	    ∀ x ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D q,
1278	      (AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x) ∨ q = dst ∨ OwnedWithin s src q) →
1279	      EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) ∧
1280	  AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff s src dst)
1281	
1282	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
1283	    Decidable (TransferPreBase k s src dst) := by
1284	  unfold TransferPreBase; infer_instance
1285	
1286	theorem transferPre_iff {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} :
1287	    TransferPre k s src dst ↔ TransferPreBase k s src dst ∧ SameShape s.P src dst := by
1288	  unfold TransferPre TransferPreBase; simp only [and_assoc]
1289	
1290	/-- `transfer` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O4). -/
1291	def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
1292	  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)
1293	
1294	/-! ## O5 `depend` (MM-03.3 §3) -/
1295	
1296	/-- Effect of `depend(result, anchor)` (MM-03.3 §3, O5): the anchor joins the dependencies of
1297	the result place; existing dependencies are kept; propagation to containing values is computed
1298	by `depsOf`. -/
1299	def dependEff (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : S3 :=
1300	  { s with D := fun r => if r = q then s.D q ++ [x] else s.D r }
1301	
1302	/-- Preconditions of `depend` (MM-03.3 §3, O5), in order: result place usable (MM-03.3.1);
1303	1 valid anchor; 5 non-escape (MM-03.3.6); B3: exercisable `Modify` on the result; C1: the frame
1304	of the effective anchor is the frame of the result or an ancestor of it (`EffAnchorOK`). O5.2
1305	(real origin of the rights or storage) is not representable: the state does not relate a value
1306	to the origin of its content. O5.3 and O5.4 hold by construction. -/
1307	def DependPre (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Prop :=
1308	  s.Usable q ∧ s.Active x ∧ NoEscape s x (s.pframe q) ∧ HasRight s .modify q ∧
1309	    EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)
1310	
1311	instance (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Decidable (DependPre s q x) := by
1312	  unfold DependPre; infer_instance
1313	
1314	/-- `depend` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O5). -/
1315	def DependStep (q x : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
1316	  Guarded (DependPre s q x) (dependEff s q x)
1317	
1318	/-! ## F4 `store` -/
1319	
1320	/-- Effect of `store a p` (F4; G2), the write of a reference into a value: `a` is now held by the
1321	place `p`; `a` joins the anchors of `p`; the leaf `p`, and it only, becomes `Init` (G2). -/
1322	def storeEff (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
1323	  | some y => { s with
1324	      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
1325	      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
1326	      I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l }
1327	  | none => s
1328	
1329	/-- Preconditions of `store a p` (F4; G2), in order: `a` active, derived (`a.origin ≠ none`), held
1330	by the current frame; `p` usable; exercisable `Modify` on `p` (B2, `HasRight`); `a` covers no leaf
1331	of `p` nor of its owned storage, transitively (A5, `OwnedIn`); `AnchorOrder` for the added
1332	anchor (C1, `EffAnchorOK`): the frame of the effective anchor of `a` is the frame of `p` or one
1333	of its ancestors. G2: `p` is a leaf, the place of a reference (MM-03.3.2, `isLeaf`); `p` holds no
1334	active authority (overwriting an `Init` leaf without authority is allowed); in the arrival state,
1335	`p` is still exercisable at `Modify` by the current frame (`HasRight`,
1336	`store_keeps_target_reachable`). G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival state. No inverse
1337	operation exists (F4). -/
1338	def StorePre (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop :=
1339	  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧
1340	  s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
1341	  (∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
1342	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q) ∧
1343	  EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p) ∧ isLeaf s.P p ∧
1344	  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p)
1345	    True) ∧
1346	  HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p)
1347	
1348	instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePre s a p) := by unfold StorePre; infer_instance
1349	
1350	/-- `store` as a relation (F4). -/
1351	def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
1352	  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)
1353	
1354	/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, A5) -/
1355	
1356	/-- Owner of the local of index `i` of `ls` (parent, owning local, kind) in the new frame `f`:
1357	the owning local if any, the new frame otherwise (A5). -/
1358	def localOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (f i : Nat) : Holder :=
1359	  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
1360	  | some o => .place o
1361	  | none => .frame f
1362	
1363	/-- Places after `enterFrame`: the locals `ls` appended, owned by the new frame `nF` or by an
1364	earlier local (A5). -/
1365	def enterP (s : S3) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Place :=
1366	  s.P ++ (List.range ls.length).map fun i =>
1367	    ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), localOwner ls s.nF i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩
1368

import Ern.MM03.Horrors

/-!
# Measure of the `NoLock` options (jalon 3, step 4)

The options of the jalon-3 material (`ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md` v2, §5), measured on the kernel as it
is (option 1, no rule), without modifying it:

* option 2, a local rule: an operation does not place an authority into a place it covers
  (`SelfLock`); `store` already rejects it (O8.3), so the rule is measured on `transfer` and
  `issue` (`opt2`);
* option 3, `NoLock`: no self-lock, as a separate clause, and the relation "`b` blocks `a`"
  (`Blocks`) acyclic, checked on the arrival state of `transfer`, `issue` and `store` (`opt3`).

For each case of the list "doit être accepté" of §5 (H11, H19, H29b, H35 to H37, H44 to H47, W1
to W3) and for H49 to H51, `decisions` gives the decision of an option on each `transfer`, `issue`
and `store` of the run of the case (`Ern.MM03.Horrors`), decided on the state where the step runs;
`true` is acceptance. The cost, measured as the brief asks (from the authorities and places the
operation touches, or the whole state): option 2 on `transfer` depends on the state only through the
places and the authorities the transfer moves (`opt2_transfer_local`), on `issue` only through the
region and the destination (`opt2_issue_local`); option 3 depends on authorities the operation does
not touch (`opt3_not_local`). Whether option 3 needs more than the function where the operation runs
(material §5, "locale à une fonction") is not settled here (report, (g)). No option is adopted (task
of jalon 3, step 4: the decision is left to arbitration).
-/

namespace Ern.MM03.LockOptions

open Ern.MM03 Ern.HandlePool Ern.MM03.Horrors

/-! ## Option 2: self-lock -/

/-- The leaves of a holder (MM-03.3.4): those of a place, none for a frame. -/
def holderLeaves (s : S3) : Holder → List Nat
  | .place p => footprint s.P p
  | .frame _ => []

/-- Self-lock of the authority `a` (material §5, options 2 and 3): `a` is active and held by a place
one of whose leaves it covers. -/
def SelfLock (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False

instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (SelfLock s a) := by unfold SelfLock; infer_instance

/-- Option 2 on `transfer src dst` (material §5): no authority moved by the transfer, one held within
the source, is self-locked in the arrival state. -/
def Opt2Transfer (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => heldIn s.P src y.holder) False →
    ¬ SelfLock (transferEff s src dst) j

instance (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (Opt2Transfer s src dst) := by
  unfold Opt2Transfer; infer_instance

/-- Option 2 on `issue` of `region` to `dst` (material §5): the block, the new authority, is not
self-locked in the arrival state. -/
def Opt2Issue (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ¬ SelfLock (issueEff s ar region dst).1 s.A.length

instance (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (Opt2Issue s ar region dst) := by
  unfold Opt2Issue; infer_instance

/-! ## Option 3: `NoLock` -/

/-- "`b` bloque `a`" (material §5, option 3): `b ≠ a`, both active, and the footprint of `b` contains
a leaf of the holder of `a`. -/
def Blocks (s : S3) (b a : Nat) : Prop :=
  b ≠ a ∧ s.Active b ∧ s.Active a ∧
    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => ∃ l ∈ s.afp b, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False

instance (s : S3) (b a : Nat) : Decidable (Blocks s b a) := by unfold Blocks; infer_instance

/-- The authorities blocked by one of `xs`. -/
def blockedBy (s : S3) (xs : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range s.A.length).filter fun a => decide (∃ b ∈ xs, Blocks s b a)

/-- The authorities reached from `xs` by at most `n` steps of `Blocks`, `xs` included. -/
def blockReach (s : S3) : Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | 0, xs => xs
  | n + 1, xs => blockReach s n (xs ++ blockedBy s xs)

/-- Acyclicity of `Blocks` (material §5, option 3): no authority is reached from itself by one or
more steps. Every step leads to an authority of `A`, so a cycle has at most `A.length` steps and the
search with that bound is complete (report, (f)). -/
def BlocksAcyclic (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∉ blockReach s s.A.length (blockedBy s [a])

instance (s : S3) : Decidable (BlocksAcyclic s) := by unfold BlocksAcyclic; infer_instance

/-- `NoLock` (material §5, option 3): no self-lock (separate clause) and `Blocks` acyclic. -/
def NoLock (s : S3) : Prop :=
  (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ SelfLock s a) ∧ BlocksAcyclic s

instance (s : S3) : Decidable (NoLock s) := by unfold NoLock; infer_instance

/-! ## Decisions along the runs -/

/-- Option 2 on an operation from the extended state `ps` (`true`: accepted by the rule). Only
`transfer` and `issue` are checked; `store` is left to O8.3. -/
def opt2 (ps : PS) : Op → Bool
  | .transfer src dst => decide (Opt2Transfer ps.s src dst)
  | .issue i _ region dst =>
    match ps.s.arenas[i]? with
    | some ar => decide (Opt2Issue ps.s ar region dst)
    | none => true
  | _ => true

/-- Option 3 on an operation from `ps` (`true`: accepted by the rule): `NoLock` of the arrival
state of `transfer`, `issue` and `store`. -/
def opt3 (ps : PS) : Op → Bool
  | .transfer src dst => decide (NoLock (transferEff ps.s src dst))
  | .issue i _ region dst =>
    match ps.s.arenas[i]? with
    | some ar => decide (NoLock (arenaSet (issueEff ps.s ar region dst).1 i
        (issueEff ps.s ar region dst).2))
    | none => true
  | .store a p => decide (NoLock (storeEff ps.s a p))
  | _ => true

/-- The operations checked by the options: `transfer`, `issue`, `store`. -/
def checked : Op → Bool
  | .transfer .. => true
  | .issue .. => true
  | .store .. => true
  | _ => false

/-- The decisions of the option `D` on the checked steps of a run of `K0` from `ps`, each on the
state where the step runs, in order, as long as the steps are `ok` in the kernel. -/
def decisions (D : PS → Op → Bool) (ps : PS) : List Op → List Bool
  | [] => []
  | o :: os =>
    match pexec K0 ps o with
    | some ps' => (if checked o then [D ps o] else []) ++ decisions D ps' os
    | none => []

/-- The run from `S3.init []` of a case. -/
def dec2 (os : List Op) : List Bool := decisions opt2 (PS.init []) os
def dec3 (os : List Op) : List Bool := decisions opt3 (PS.init []) os

/-! ## Cases that must be accepted (material §5) -/

/-- The runs of the cases that must be accepted, with their names: each is a run of
`Ern.MM03.Horrors` reached under `K0`, except H21's arena which is not on the list. -/
def mustAccept : List (String × List Op) :=
  [("H11", h11p ++ [.endUse 3, .endUse 6, .reset 0 0]),
   ("H19", h19p ++ [.endUse 2, .reset 0 0]),
   ("H29b", h29bo), ("H35", h35o), ("H36", h36o), ("H37", h37o), ("H44", h44o),
   ("H45", h45o), ("H46", h46o), ("H47", h47o), ("W1", w1o),
   ("W2", w2o ++ [.release 12, .release 11, .transfer 9 16, .transfer 12 19]),
   ("W3", w3o ++ [.endUse 5, .endUse 2, .endUse 3, .endUse 4, .reset 0 0, .issue 0 0 [10] 2]),
   ("W3v", w3vo ++ [.endUse 2, .reset 0 0, .issue 0 0 [10] 3])]

/-- Every run of the list is `ok` in the kernel at each step, so the decisions cover all its
checked steps. -/
theorem mustAccept_runs : mustAccept.all (fun c => (prun K0 (PS.init []) c.2).isSome) = true := by
  decide

/-- The decisions of option 2 on the checked steps of each case. -/
theorem opt2_decisions : mustAccept.map (fun c => (c.1, dec2 c.2)) =
    [("H11", [true, true, true]), ("H19", [true]), ("H29b", [true]), ("H35", []),
     ("H36", []), ("H37", [true]), ("H44", [true]), ("H45", [true, true, true, true]),
     ("H46", [true]), ("H47", [true]), ("W1", []), ("W2", [true, true]),
     ("W3", [true, true, true, true, true, true, true]), ("W3v", [true, true, true, true, true, true, true])] := by
  decide

/-- The decisions of option 3 on the checked steps of each case. -/
theorem opt3_decisions : mustAccept.map (fun c => (c.1, dec3 c.2)) =
    [("H11", [true, true, true]), ("H19", [true]), ("H29b", [true]), ("H35", []),
     ("H36", []), ("H37", [true]), ("H44", [true]), ("H45", [true, true, true, true]),
     ("H46", [true]), ("H47", [true]), ("W1", []), ("W2", [true, true]),
     ("W3", [true, true, true, true, true, true, true]), ("W3v", [true, true, true, true, true, true, true])] := by
  decide

/-- No false rejection (material §5, criterion): neither option rejects a checked step of a case that
must be accepted. -/
theorem no_false_rejection : mustAccept.all (fun c => (dec2 c.2).all id && (dec3 c.2).all id) =
    true := by
  decide

/-! ## Residual blockings (H49 to H51) -/

/-- H49 (the cycle closed through a helper then its `release`): option 2 accepts every checked step,
so the blocking of H49 remains; option 3 rejects the `store` that closes the cycle (the fourth checked
step), the helper notwithstanding. -/
theorem H49_options : dec2 h49o = [true, true, true, true] ∧
    dec3 h49o = [true, true, true, false] := by
  decide

/-- The state and the step of H49 where option 3 rejects: `store 8 6` with the helper 9 active; in
its arrival state, 7 and 8 block each other. -/
theorem H49_cycle : Blocks (storeEff (run K0 [] (h48o ++ [.derive 7 6 .modify])).s 8 6) 7 8 ∧
    Blocks (storeEff (run K0 [] (h48o ++ [.derive 7 6 .modify])).s 8 6) 8 7 :=
  by decide

/-- H50 (an authority transferred or issued into the place it covers): both options reject the
`transfer` and the `issue`, by the self-lock. -/
theorem H50_options : dec2 h50ao = [true, false] ∧ dec3 h50ao = [true, false] ∧
    dec2 h50bo = [false] ∧ dec3 h50bo = [false] := by
  decide

/-- H51 (an element of a storage owned by `v` holds a view on `v`): option 2 accepts the `store`, and
would even if it checked `store`: the view is not self-locked, the configuration being a cycle of
two authorities, which option 2 does not cover (material §5); the blocking remains. Option 3 rejects
the `store`: in its arrival state, the root of the storage, held by `v`, and the view, held by the
element, block each other. -/
theorem H51_options : dec2 h51o = [true] ∧ dec3 h51o = [false] ∧
    ¬ SelfLock (storeEff (run K0 [] (h51o.take 6)).s 4 3) 4 ∧
    Blocks (storeEff (run K0 [] (h51o.take 6)).s 4 3) 2 4 ∧
    Blocks (storeEff (run K0 [] (h51o.take 6)).s 4 3) 4 2 := by
  decide

/-! ## Cost of the check -/

/-- Locality of option 2 on `transfer`: the decision depends on the state only through the places and
the authorities held within the source, the ones the transfer moves. Two states with the same places
and the same such authorities, at the same identities, get the same decision. -/
theorem opt2_transfer_local {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hP : s'.P = s.P)
    (hA : ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), (s.A[j]? = some y ∨ s'.A[j]? = some y) →
      heldIn s.P src y.holder → s'.A[j]? = s.A[j]?) :
    Opt2Transfer s' src dst ↔ Opt2Transfer s src dst := by
  have key : ∀ (t t' : S3), t'.P = t.P →
      (∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), (t.A[j]? = some y ∨ t'.A[j]? = some y) →
        heldIn t.P src y.holder → t'.A[j]? = t.A[j]?) →
      Opt2Transfer t src dst → Opt2Transfer t' src dst := by
    intro t t' hP hA h j hj hheld hsl
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hh⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hheld
    rw [hP] at hh
    have e := hA j y (.inr hy) hh
    have hy' : t.A[j]? = some y := e.symm.trans hy
    refine h j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy')) (optP_false_iff.2 ⟨y, hy', hh⟩) ?_
    have ga : (transferEff t' src dst).A[j]? = (transferEff t src dst).A[j]? := by
      rw [transfer_A_get, transfer_A_get, e, hP]
    have gl : holderLeaves (transferEff t' src dst) = holderLeaves (transferEff t src dst) := by
      funext hd
      cases hd with
      | place p => simp only [holderLeaves, transferEff, hP]
      | frame f => rfl
    unfold SelfLock at hsl ⊢
    rw [ga, gl] at hsl
    exact hsl
  refine ⟨key s' s hP.symm (fun j y hy hh => ?_), key s s' hP hA⟩
  rw [hP] at hh
  exact (hA j y hy.symm hh).symm

/-- Option 2 on `issue` reads only the region and the destination: the block is self-locked exactly
when the destination's footprint meets the region. -/
theorem opt2_issue_local (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Opt2Issue s ar region dst ↔ ¬ ∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P dst := by
  unfold Opt2Issue SelfLock
  simp only [issueEff, S3.addAuth, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_refl _), Nat.sub_self,
    List.getElem?_cons_zero, OptP, true_and, holderLeaves]

/-- The states of `opt3_not_local`: the state of H48 with the helper 9 (`Modify` on the node 6,
derived from 7), and the same run without the `store` of 7, which stays held by the frame. -/
def nl1 : PS := run K0 [] (h48o ++ [.derive 7 6 .modify])
def nl2 : PS := run K0 [] (fao ++ [.derive 6 6 .modify, .derive 5 5 .modify, .derive 7 6 .modify])

/-- Option 3 is not local to the operation: in two reached states where the kernel accepts
`store 8 6`, with the same places, the same stored authority 8 and as many authorities, the decisions
differ. The states differ by the authority 7, which the step does not touch (stored into the node 5
in the first, held by the frame in the second), and by the initialisation and anchors of the node 5,
which option 3 does not read. Both states are in one frame (report, (g)). -/
theorem opt3_not_local :
    PReach K0 [] nl1 ∧ PReach K0 [] nl2 ∧
    StoreStep 8 6 nl1.s (.ok (storeEff nl1.s 8 6)) ∧ StoreStep 8 6 nl2.s (.ok (storeEff nl2.s 8 6)) ∧
    nl1.s.P = nl2.s.P ∧ nl1.s.A[8]? = nl2.s.A[8]? ∧ nl1.s.A.length = nl2.s.A.length ∧
    nl1.s.A[7]? ≠ nl2.s.A[7]? ∧ nl1.s.F = nl2.s.F ∧
    ¬ NoLock (storeEff nl1.s 8 6) ∧ NoLock (storeEff nl2.s 8 6) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .ok (by decide),
    .ok (by decide), by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

## 3. Contrat commun des transitions

### 3.1 — Issues

Toute opération a une issue conceptuelle parmi :

```text
Outcome3 = ok(new_state) | reject | fail
```

`reject` signifie que la discipline statique n'autorise pas le pas ; ce n'est ni un trap runtime implicite, ni un `ub` de MM-02. `fail` est un **échec défini**, laissant l'état inchangé ; seules `alloc` et `issue` peuvent l'émettre dans ce noyau. Pour toutes les autres opérations, l'issue est `ok` ou `reject`. Pour `alloc` et `issue`, le contrôle des préconditions statiques précède la détermination de l'échec dynamique, sauf les précisions d'ordre de contrôle indiquées dans leurs règles.

Une transition `ok` doit respecter ses préconditions, appliquer exactement ses effets prescrits et conserver les invariants pertinents. Aucune transition ne fabrique une permission pour rendre sa conclusion vraie. Les changements de détention et d'ancres s'évaluent sur l'**état d'arrivée** lorsqu'une règle le prévoit explicitement.

### 3.2 — Suspension, ancrage, initialisation

Les changements d'autorité effective sont **dérivés** des autorités actives et de leurs origines ; aucune mutation d'un indicateur `Suspended` n'est effectuée. Les opérations d'accès ne changent pas une ancre sans effet de transfert, de `depend`, de `store`, de libération ou de ré-ancrage explicitement autorisé. Les feuilles qui deviennent `Init` proviennent d'une écriture admise (`write3`, `writeShared`, `store`, `issue`) ou d'un transfert depuis une feuille source déjà `Init` et correspondante ; les feuilles initialisées dans `S3.init` sont déclarées comme telles.

### O1 — `derive(source, region, mode)`

**Préconditions**

1. `source` est une autorité dérivée ou racine active, `ExercisableAt(s,source,mode)` est vrai ; sa chaîne d'origines et ses ancres sont valides.
2. Les feuilles de `region` existent et appartiennent à l'empreinte de `source` ; `mode` n'excède pas le droit effectif disponible sur ces feuilles.
3. L'ajout conserve l'exclusivité I1 : aucune autorité active non apparentée ne devient incompatible avec le droit dérivé, et les descendants déjà actifs sont respectés.
4. Le nouveau cadre détenteur est le cadre courant, vivant. Les restrictions d'empreinte et d'ancrage de l'état admissible restent vraies.

**Effet `ok`** : une autorité d'identité fraîche, d'origine `source`, de mode et d'empreinte demandés, active et détenue par le cadre courant, est ajoutée. La source demeure active ; ses modes effectifs se recalculent par feuille. Aucun stockage ni ancre d'emplacement n'est créé. Les observations multiples compatibles restent permises. **Autre issue :** `reject`.

### O2 — `split(source, regions)`

**Préconditions**

1. `source` est active et exerçable par le cadre courant avec un droit de modification suffisant sur les feuilles concernées.
2. Chaque région est comprise dans l'empreinte disponible et effectivement modifiable de la source.
3. Les régions sont deux à deux disjointes, au sens de la structure ou du contrat `K.DeclaredDisjoint`, sous l'obligation `DDSound(K)` ; aucun droit exclusif déjà distribué n'est recouvert.
4. La création des dérivées respecte les origines, la conservation I1/I2 et les obligations de validité.

**Effet `ok`** : une autorité dérivée `Modify`, active et détenue par le cadre courant, est créée pour chaque région. `source` reste active ; sa capacité effective de modification disparaît seulement sur les feuilles distribuées, et demeure sur les feuilles non distribuées. Les autorités sont séparées logiquement : aucune allocation physique n'est réalisée par `split`. **Autre issue :** `reject`.

Une déclaration de disjonction non fondée peut invalider la preuve : sans `DDSound`, un `split` accepté peut violer I1. La construction de sous-régions de taille nulle n'est pas identifiée à une allocation de MM-02 ; le cas de la forme vide d'`alloc` est distinct.

### O3 — `release(authority)`

**Préconditions**

1. `authority` est active **et dérivée** : une autorité sans origine est rejetée.
2. Elle est détenue par le cadre courant, ou détenue par un emplacement `p` sur lequel le cadre courant dispose de `Modify` exerçable.
3. Aucun descendant actif de l'autorité n'empêche sa libération ; aucune autre valeur encore utilisable ne doit perdre une ancre nécessaire.
4. Si l'autorité est stockée dans son emplacement détenteur, celui-ci est exempté du contrôle « cette autorité figure encore dans les ancres » **uniquement parce que l'effet supprime cette ancre simultanément**. Une ancre de même identité attachée par `depend` à un autre emplacement utilisable continue de bloquer le pas.
5. Les contrats applicables des abstractions restent satisfaits.

**Effet `ok`** : l'autorité devient inactive et ne peut plus être exercée. Elle est retirée des ancres de son emplacement détenteur lorsqu'elle y était stockée. Les modes effectifs de ses origines sont recalculés, permettant la restitution des droits non bloqués. Il n'y a aucune désallocation implicite. **Autre issue :** `reject`.

### O4 — `transfer(source, destination)`

**Préconditions**

1. `source` et `destination` sont utilisables, et le cadre courant dispose de `Modify` exerçable sur leurs empreintes pertinentes.
2. La source et la destination ont la **même forme de sous-arbres ordonnés**. Le `i`-ième enfant de chaque partie source correspond au `i`-ième enfant de la partie destination correspondante ; tous les nœuds sont appariés. L'identité d'un champ structurel est sa position, non un appariement arbitraire des enfants.
3. **Toutes** les feuilles de la source sont `Init` et **aucune** feuille de la destination n'est `Init`. Les empreintes source et destination sont disjointes.
4. Aucune autorité exclusive n'est dupliquée ; la validité des autorités dérivées et des projections actives est préservée.
5. **Aucune feuille en place de la source n’est épinglée**, statiquement (`K.Pinned`) ou dynamiquement (`pin`). Le stockage seulement **possédé** par la source, qui n’est pas lui-même déplacé par le transfert de cette valeur, n’empêche pas ce transfert.
6. Les dépendances de tous les emplacements encore utilisables qui suivent la valeur restent valides ; les contraintes de non-échappement et `AnchorOrder` sont vérifiées dans **l'état d'arrivée**, y compris les ancres transférées des emplacements possédés encore utilisables.
7. Toutes les autorités détenues déplacées, y compris celles du stockage possédé, satisfont `AnchorOrderHeld` dans l’état d’arrivée ; aucune autorité ne peut échapper à une ancre locale sous prétexte que sa valeur porteuse a été transférée.
8. **Prévention locale de l’auto-blocage (option 2).** Pour toute autorité active détenue avant le pas par une partie `r` de `source`, et dont le détenteur devient la partie correspondante `corr(r)` de `destination`, l’empreinte de cette autorité ne contient **aucune feuille** de `corr(r)` dans l’état d’arrivée. Le transfert est rejeté si ce contrôle local échoue ; aucune vérification d’acyclicité globale des autorités n’est imposée.

**Effet `ok`** :

- chaque feuille source devient `Moved` et chaque feuille de destination correspondante devient `Init` ;
- chaque autorité détenue par la partie source `r` a pour nouveau détenteur la partie correspondante `corr(r)` de la destination, et non indistinctement la racine de destination ;
- les emplacements possédés par `r` passent sous la possession de `corr(r)` ; leurs racines suivent ce propriétaire conformément à `RootHeld` ;
- les dépendances de la valeur suivent les emplacements correspondants, sous les garanties de validité ; aucune autorité n'est créée ou dupliquée ;
- les emplacements de destination récupèrent les valeurs et droits transférés sans déplacer automatiquement le stockage dont une partie de la source n'est pas propriétaire.

**Autre issue :** `reject`. Le cas de `transfer` vers un résultat d'appel est soumis à ces mêmes règles.

Une structure partiellement initialisée peut être transférée **champ par champ**, seulement pour les champs individuellement transférables. Cela ne déstructure pas automatiquement une valeur qui possède du stockage **au niveau du contenant** : ce stockage reste au contenant si le contenant n'est pas transféré. Le passage entre structures dont les champs sont permutés est une conversion à traiter séparément, pas un `transfer`.


### O5 — `depend(result, anchor)`

**Préconditions**

1. `result` est un emplacement utilisable sur lequel le cadre courant dispose de `Modify` exerçable.
2. `anchor` désigne une autorité active et valide, représentant une dépendance effective des droits ou du stockage concernés ; une dépendance déclarée ne peut pas prolonger une origine.
3. Les ancres existantes sont conservées et l'ajout respecte `AnchorOrder` : le cadre de l'ancre effective est celui de `result` ou un ancêtre de ce cadre.
4. Toute dépendance portée par une valeur contenue reste représentée dans les obligations transitives de son contenant.

**Effet `ok`** : `anchor` est ajouté à `D(result)` ; les dépendances transitives du contenant en tiennent compte. Aucun droit d'accès supplémentaire n'est créé. **Autre issue :** `reject`.

Une interface sûre doit déclarer des dépendances couvrant celles réellement exigées par son implémentation ; l'annotation elle-même n'est pas présumée vraie. Une abstraction non sûre porte les obligations de son contrat.

### O8 — `store(authority, target)`

**Préconditions**

1. `authority` est active, **dérivée**, et détenue par le cadre courant ; une autorité racine ne peut jamais être rangée par `store`.
2. `target` est une **feuille** utilisable, sous `Modify` exerçable par le cadre courant. Elle ne détient aucune autre autorité **active**. Le fait que ses données soient déjà `Init` n'interdit pas à lui seul l'opération.
3. L'autorité stockée ne couvre ni une feuille de `target` ni les feuilles du stockage qu'il possède transitivement.
4. L'ancre effective de `authority` respecte `AnchorOrder` vis-à-vis du cadre de `target` ; les autres dépendances sont préservées.
5. **Dans l'état d'arrivée**, `target` reste sous `Modify` exerçable pour le cadre courant (`store_keeps_target_reachable`) et `AnchorOrderHeld` reste vrai. Cette clause est une vraie précondition supplémentaire et non une conséquence automatique des précédentes.

**Effet `ok`** : le détenteur de `authority` devient `target` ; l'autorité est ajoutée à `D(target)` ; **seule** la feuille `target` devient `Init`. Les autres champs d'une structure, même voisine, ne changent pas d'initialisation. **Autre issue :** `reject`.

Écraser une autorité active déjà détenue par la feuille est interdit ; sa libération explicite peut rendre la cible réutilisable. La clause d'arrivée n'interdit pas à elle seule tous les cycles possibles après d'autres opérations : l'absence générale de blocage (`NoLock`) n'est pas adoptée ici.

### O9 — `read3(region, access)`

**Préconditions**

## 5. Décision `NoLock` — cadrage

**Fait établi (passe 7).** Des états atteints contiennent des autorités détenues que personne ne peut exercer, ce qui bloque un `reset` ou un `free` jusqu'à la mort d'une ressource englobante (H49–H51). Ces états respectent tous les invariants de sûreté ; la charte exclut les interblocages du contrat de sûreté (§4.1). C'est une question d'ergonomie et de progrès, pas de sûreté.

**Options**

1. **Aucune règle** (référence de comparaison). Les blocages sont admis ; les relations persistantes passent par des handles par convention.
2. **Règle locale.** Interdire qu'une opération place une autorité dans un emplacement qu'elle couvre (auto-blocage). O8 l'interdit déjà pour `store` ; le gain à mesurer porte sur `transfer` et `issue`. Ne couvre pas les cycles de longueur ≥ 2 construits par autorité auxiliaire.
3. **`NoLock` global.** Acyclicité de la relation « `b` bloque `a` », auto-blocage défini comme clause séparée, vérifiée à l'arrivée de `transfer`, `issue`, `store`.

**Mesures à produire au jalon 3, pour chaque option :**
- faux rejets sur les cas qui doivent être acceptés : H11, H19, H29b, H35–H37, H44–H47, W1–W3 ;
- blocages résiduels sur H49–H51 ;
- coût d'analyse : la vérification est-elle locale à une fonction, ou exige-t-elle une analyse globale ?

**Critère de choix** : aucune option n'est adoptée si elle rejette un cas qui doit être accepté. Entre options sans faux rejet, la moins coûteuse à analyser l'emporte.

---

## 5b. Scénarios d'usage (exigences de validation, pas une description de l'implémentation actuelle de Weld)

| ID | Structure | Séquence | Attendu |
|---|---|---|---|
| W1 | Graphe de scène | Pool de nœuds `{data, parent : handle, child : handle}` sur une allocation ; deux nœuds liés dans les deux sens par handles ; `resolve` `Modify` d'un nœud, écriture de `data`, `unresolve` ; `freeSlot` d'un nœud encore désigné par le handle de l'autre ; `resolve` de ce handle ; `freeSlot` pendant une résolution active | tout `ok` ; `resolve` du handle périmé : `fail` ; `freeSlot` pendant résolution : `reject` |
| W2 | ECS archetype + sparse set | Archetype à deux colonnes (SoA) sur une allocation ; `split` des colonnes ; système A écrit la colonne 1 pendant que le système B lit la colonne 2 ; `resolveMany` `Modify` de trois entités distinctes d'un pool d'entités ; déplacement d'une entité vers un autre archetype (transferts des champs de la ligne) pendant qu'une vue de colonne est active, puis après sa libération | lectures et écritures disjointes `ok` ; `resolveMany` `ok` ; déplacement pendant la vue : `reject` ; après : `ok` |
| W3 | Arène de frame | `alloc`, `newArena`, trois `issue`, trois vues rangées (`store`) dans une structure locale ; `reset` pendant que les vues vivent ; `endUse` de la structure ; `reset` ; réémission | `reset` pendant : `reject` ; après : `ok` ; réémission `ok` |

## 6. Registre des obligations inter-spécifications

## 7. Registre de la reconstruction de référence

# Annexe F — Registre de reconstruction de référence (non normatif)

La reconstruction de référence doit repartir du texte **validé**, et non des approximations du brouillon. Les éléments suivants ne sont pas tous prouvés à ce stade :

1. **Six écarts du brouillon MM-03** (`MM23_v0.1.md`, section (f)) : (i) feuilles lues/écrites utilisables, (ii) empreintes composées uniquement de feuilles, (iii) `alloc` créant une racine unique, (iv) marques de mort transitives après `free` et `endUse`, (v) `RootLive`/`RootHeld`, (vi) bonne fondation des chaînes de possession.
2. **Locaux de `enterFrame`** : rendre explicite que les locaux créés par l'opération sont possédés directement par le cadre ; une forme de local ayant pour propriétaire un autre local n'est pas une forme de `enterFrame` admise.
3. **Jalon 2 — décisions 1 à 4** : (i) disjonction déclarée des **feuilles**, à justifier par la bibliothèque, puis disjonction des plages d'octets sous `LayoutWF` ; (ii) adresse/provenance d'une région vide = base/allocation de son ancre effective ; (iii) pour une région non vide, adresse minimale des feuilles de taille non nulle, sans confondre pointeur et représentation d'une région non contiguë ; (iv) feuille recevant une référence de taille exactement adaptée au pointeur et `decode` lisant uniquement ces octets (obligations Specs 4/11).
4. **Jalon 2 — autres points** : `SameSizeAlong` demeure à la Spec 4, `Repr` inclut `MM02.WF`, `freeSound_derived` et fournisseur conservé, simulation conditionnelle à paramètres fixés ; ne pas présenter le théorème de simulation comme une validation autonome de tous les contenus binaires.
5. **Induction d'initialisation** : toute feuille `Init` atteinte l'était à l'état initial ou provient d'une écriture autorisée, d'un transfert légal ou d'une émission écrivant explicitement sa destination. **Correspondance `Step` / `Reachable`** : démontrer la liaison des constructeurs et transitions opérationnelles générales, non seulement les cas isolés.
6. **Reconstruction `HandlePool`** : réénoncer et prouver `PoolInv` corrigé ; prouver l'effet de `freeSlot` sous `MetaRight`, notamment lorsque seul `writeShared` autorise la mutation des métadonnées ; vérifier `resolveMany Observe`, les deux registres et le stockage `Uninit` de `newPool` ; vérifier la propriété d'exclusivité à travers toutes les opérations du noyau.
7. **Corpus MM2-H** : exécuter les 17 identifiants d'origine (H13 scindé en H13a/H13b, donc 18 scénarios) sur la reconstruction de référence, et non sur le vieux brouillon ; conserver les cas de formation d'adresse et reconstruction de pointeur non tranchés par MM-02.G comme obligations, sans les décréter réussis.
8. **MM23-H15/H16** : enregistrer et corriger les écarts connus de pointeurs vides/ordre des feuilles, sans les présenter comme des preuves déjà acquises.
9. **Option 2 `NoLock`** : reconstruire et vérifier la nouvelle précondition locale de O4 et O18 ; H49 et H51 restent des limites d'ergonomie (cycles d'autorités, non UB) ; l'option 3 globale n'est pas adoptée.
10. **Appels** : enregistrer la primitive de `sink` à l'entrée d'appel et les conditions du ré-emprunt H01 pour la Spec 3, sans les introduire silencieusement dans les transitions courantes de MM-03.

La reconstruction utilisera un journal de traçabilité clause → définition → théorème → cas, et distinguera l'ensemble des garanties effectivement prouvées des conditions de programme bien typé, d'ABI et de bibliothèque.

exact hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 l (List.mem_range.2 hl.lt) hl

/-! ## `alloc` (B5, C6, C9) -/

/-- Outcomes of `alloc` (B5): `ok`; `fail`, a defined failure of the allocator contract, with the
state unchanged; `reject` by the static discipline (MM-03.3 §3). -/
inductive AOutcome where
  | ok (s : S3)
  | fail (s : S3)
  | reject

/-- Right to update the metadata of the allocator value at `provider` (B5): exercisable `Modify` on
`provider`, or a `writeShared` right (A9) on its leaves, all `SharedMutable`. -/
def ProviderRight (k : K) (s : S3) (provider : Nat) : Prop :=
  HasRight s .modify provider ∨
  ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.ExercisableAt via .observe ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, effective s via l ≠ none ∧ k.SharedMutable l ∧ DepsValid s l

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (provider : Nat) :
    Decidable (ProviderRight k s provider) := by
  unfold ProviderRight; infer_instance

/-- Owner of the element of index `i` of a shape `ls` (A5; C6): its owning element if any, `hd`
otherwise. The owner of a local of `enterFrame` is the case `hd = .frame f` (`localOwner`). -/
def shapeOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (hd : Holder) (i : Nat) : Holder :=
  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
  | some o => .place o
  | none => hd

/-- Places `P` followed by the elements of the shape `ls` (C6: the encoding of the locals of
`enterFrame`, an indexed forest of (parent, owning element, kind)); the elements without owning
element are owned by `hd` (A5). -/
def shapeP (P : List Place) (hd : Holder) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
    List Place :=
  P ++ (List.range ls.length).map fun i =>
    ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), shapeOwner ls hd i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩

/-- `enterFrame` lays out its locals as a shape (C6). -/
theorem enterP_eq_shapeP (s : S3) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
    enterP s ls = shapeP s.P (.frame s.nF) ls := rfl

/-- Well-formed shape at offset `n` (MM-03.3 §4, O6; C6): the parent and the owning element of an
element are earlier elements, and a part has the owning element of its parent. It is the clause
of `EnterPre` on the locals (`enterPre_shapeOK`). -/
def ShapeOK (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => n ≤ r ∧ r < n + i ∧
      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - n]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => n ≤ o ∧ o < n + i) True

instance (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Decidable (ShapeOK n ls) := by
  unfold ShapeOK; infer_instance

theorem enterPre_shapeOK {s : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (h : EnterPreBase s ps ls) : ShapeOK s.P.length ls := h.2.2

/-- Static preconditions of `alloc provider owner shape` (B5; C6; D2): the allocator value at
`provider` is usable, with the right to update its metadata; the place `owner`, which receives
the ownership, is usable, with exercisable `Modify`; the leaves of the provider are `Init`; the
shape is well-formed and not empty (D2: an allocation of size zero is a shape of one leaf). -/
def AllocStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat)
    (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  s.Usable provider ∧ ProviderRight k s provider ∧ s.Usable owner ∧ HasRight s .modify owner ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init) ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls ∧ ls ≠ []

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat)
    (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Decidable (AllocStatic k s provider owner ls) := by
  unfold AllocStatic; infer_instance

/-- Places after `alloc` (B5; C6): the elements of the shape appended, those without owning
element owned by `owner`. -/
def allocP (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Place :=
  shapeP s.P (.place owner) ls

/-- Effect of `alloc provider owner shape` (B5; C6): the elements of the shape appended as places
of fresh identities, `Uninit`, without anchor, alive, not freed, not pinned; one root authority
`Modify` per root element, on its footprint, held by the owner of the element (A4); the metadata
of the provider, its leaves, set to `Init`. The shape is abstract: it fixes neither alignment nor
layout (milestone 2). -/
def allocEff (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := allocP s owner ls
    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit
      else if l ∈ footprint s.P provider then .init else s.I l
    A := s.A ++ (rootIdx ls).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP s owner ls) (s.P.length + i),
        shapeOwner ls (.place owner) i, true⟩
    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q

/-- `alloc provider owner shape` as a relation (B5; C6; C9): `reject` when a static precondition
fails; `fail`, with the state unchanged, when the allocator contract cannot satisfy the request in
the current state (`Satisfiable`); `ok` otherwise. -/
inductive AllocStep (k : K) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat))
    (s : S3) : AOutcome → Prop where
  | ok : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
      AllocStep k provider owner ls s (.ok (allocEff s provider owner ls))
  | fail : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → ¬ k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
      AllocStep k provider owner ls s (.fail s)
  | reject : ¬ AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → AllocStep k provider owner ls s .reject

/-- Determinism of `alloc` (B5). -/
theorem alloc_det {k : K} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {s : S3}
    {o₁ o₂ : AOutcome} (h₁ : AllocStep k pr ow ls s o₁) (h₂ : AllocStep k pr ow ls s o₂) :
    o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction

    · exact .inr ⟨hn, Mode.le_observe h⟩
  · exact h.elim

/-! ## Invariants (MM-03.3 §2, A1) -/

/-- I1, effective exclusivity strengthened structurally (MM-03.3 §2, A1): two distinct active
authorities, unrelated by `origin`, covering the same leaf, `SharedMutable` leaves included,
both have the proper mode `Observe`. The pass-1 statement on effective modes is the theorem
`effective_compat`. -/
def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe

/-- I2, conservation of authorities (MM-03.3 §2): the origin of a derived authority exists, and
on each leaf of the derived footprint, the leaf is in the footprint of the origin and the
derived mode does not exceed the origin's. -/
def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ ∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint ∧ y.mode.le x.mode

/-- I3, validity of dependencies (MM-03.3 §2): every anchor of a usable place is valid, that is,
active (pass-1 arbitrage 2). -/
def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

/-- I4, validity of consumed values (MM-03.3 §2), first sentence as a state predicate: no
`Moved` leaf is readable. The other sentences concern `transfer` and are theorems. -/
def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ a p, s.I p = .moved → ¬ CanReadLeaf s a p

/-- `AnchorOrder` (B8 as corrected by C1): for every usable place and every anchor of it, the
frame of the effective anchor (`S3.effAnchor`, the root of the chain of origins) is the frame of
the place or one of its ancestors (MM-03.3.1, `ancestor`). It holds for every anchor. -/
def AnchorOrder (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4`, the invariant `Inv3` written in MM-03.3 §2, before the clause
`AnchorOrder` that B8 adds to it. -/
def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s

/-- `NoDangling` (C2): no active authority covers a leaf of a place that is not usable in the sense
of `Usable` (existence, `dead` mark, chain of owners). It says nothing of initialisation: a leaf
`Uninit` or `Moved` of a usable place may stay covered. -/
def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint

/-- `Inv3` (MM-03.3 §2; B8, C1, C2): the safety invariant,
`I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling`. -/
def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s

theorem Inv3.base {s : S3} (h : Inv3 s) : Inv3base s := h.1
theorem Inv3.ao {s : S3} (h : Inv3 s) : AnchorOrder s := h.2.1
theorem Inv3.nd {s : S3} (h : Inv3 s) : NoDangling s := h.2.2

/-- `AnchorOrder` read on the places of `P`: decidable form. -/
theorem anchorOrder_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrder s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q) :=
  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩

/-- `NoDangling` read on the authorities of `A` and on the places containing each covered leaf:
decidable form. -/
theorem noDangling_iff {s : S3} : NoDangling s ↔
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active j → ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l < s.P.length → isLeaf s.P l →
      ∀ q ∈ l :: chain (parentOf s.P) l, s.Usable q := by
  constructor
  · intro h j _ ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ l hl hlP hleaf q hq
    have hl' : l ∈ y.footprint := by simpa [S3.afp, hy] using hl
    exact Decidable.byContradiction fun hu => h j y hy ya q hu l
      (mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlP, (List.mem_cons.1 hq).imp Eq.symm id⟩) hl'
  · intro h j y hy ya q hu l hl hly
    obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf, -, hq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
    exact hu (h j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy)) ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ l
      (by simp only [S3.afp, hy]; exact hly) hlP hleaf q (List.mem_cons.2 (hq.imp Eq.symm id)))

/-- I4 holds in every state: the read condition requires `Init` (MM-03.3 §2, I4; §5). -/
theorem i4_always (s : S3) : I4 s := fun _ _ hm h => by rw [h.2.1] at hm; cases hm

/-- Root place (MM-03.3.2; B1): an existing place without parent. -/
def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none

instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- First clause of B1: two distinct root places have disjoint footprints. Parts and their
containing places are not concerned. -/
def RootsDisjoint (P : List Place) : Prop :=
  ∀ r r', RootPlace P r → RootPlace P r' → r ≠ r' → ∀ l ∈ footprint P r, l ∉ footprint P r'

/-- Second clause of B1: the chain of origins of an authority covering a leaf ends at the root
authority of the root place of that leaf, an authority without origin whose footprint is the
footprint of that root place. -/
def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- A4, "Une racine reste détenue par le propriétaire de son emplacement", a possession condition
that A1 keeps in `WF3`: an authority without origin is held by the owner of the root place of
every leaf it covers. -/
def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner

/-- `WF3` (A1, A4, B1, C3): well-formedness, the domain of admissible states, separate from the
safety invariant `Inv3`. Origins precede their derivations; footprints are made of existing
places; the stack is non-empty and without duplicates, below `nF`; owner frames are below `nF`;
owner places exist; a part comes after its parent and has its owner and its `dead` flag; every
active authority has a live holder (possession); B1: the chain of origins of an authority covering
a leaf ends at the root authority of its root place (`RootChain`); A4: a root is held by the owner
of its place (`RootHeld`). C3: the first clause of B1, `RootsDisjoint`, is not a clause: it holds
for every list of places (`rootsDisjoint_always`). -/
def WF3 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  (∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b) ∧
  (∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, l < s.P.length) ∧
  s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ (∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF) ∧
  (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f → f < s.nF) ∧
  (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
    o < s.P.length) ∧
  (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q) ∧
  (∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → HolderLive s y.holder) ∧
  RootChain s ∧ RootHeld s

/-- The pass-1 exclusivity on effective modes (MM-03.3 §2, I1) is a theorem under the
strengthened I1 (A1). -/
theorem effective_compat {s : S3} (h : I1 s) :
    ∀ a b p m₁ m₂, a ≠ b → effective s a p = some m₁ → effective s b p = some m₂ →
      Compat m₁ m₂ := by

  have obs₁ : x.mode = .observe → m₁ = .observe := fun hm => by
    rcases effOf_cases ex with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ <;> simp [hm]
  have obs₂ : y.mode = .observe → m₂ = .observe := fun hm => by
    rcases effOf_cases ey with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ <;> simp [hm]
  by_cases hba : b ∈ s.ancs a
  · have hm : x.mode ∈ descModes s b p := mem_descModes.2 ⟨a, x, hx, xa, xp, hba, rfl⟩
    rcases effOf_cases ey with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, hn, rfl⟩
    · simp [h0] at hm
    · have : x.mode = .observe := mode_eq_observe fun e => hn (e ▸ hm)
      exact ⟨obs₁ this, rfl⟩
  by_cases hab' : a ∈ s.ancs b
  · have hm : y.mode ∈ descModes s a p := mem_descModes.2 ⟨b, y, hy, ya, yp, hab', rfl⟩
    rcases effOf_cases ex with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, hn, rfl⟩
    · simp [h0] at hm
    · have : y.mode = .observe := mode_eq_observe fun e => hn (e ▸ hm)
      exact ⟨rfl, obs₂ this⟩
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h a b x y p hab hx hy xa ya xp yp hab' hba
  exact ⟨obs₁ h₁, obs₂ h₂⟩

/-- `effective_exclusive` (MM-03.3 §10): under I1, an authority with effective `Modify` on a leaf
is the only one with a present effective mode there. -/
theorem effective_exclusive {s : S3} (h : I1 s) {a b p : Nat} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : effective s a p = some .modify) : effective s b p = none := by
  cases hb : effective s b p with

        obtain ⟨r', e, hr'⟩ := mvTo_part hwf hdst.lt hh

        rw [e]; exact transfer_usable_part hwf hr' hd'
      · cases hh : y₀.holder with
        | frame f => rw [hh] at hl; exact hl
        | place p => rw [hh] at hl; exact transfer_usable_fwd hwf hd' hl
  · have hq' := transfer_usable_back hwf hsrc hq
    refine sk.active.2 ?_
    simp only [transferEff] at hx
    split at hx
    · rename_i hqd; subst hqd; rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx | hx
      · exact i3 _ hq' x hx
      · exact h5 x hx
    · split at hx
      · simp at hx
      · exact i3 q hq' x hx

/-- `transfer_no_duplicate_authority` (MM-03.3 §3, O4.3; §2, I4; §10; A4): no authority is
created or duplicated, each keeps mode, origin, footprint and activity; an authority held by the
source or one of its parts is now held by the corresponding part of the destination (`mvTo`, J1);
the others keep their holder, so a root held by a frame never moves. -/
theorem transfer_no_duplicate_authority {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
    SameSkel s s' ∧ ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[b]? = some y →
      s'.A[b]? = some (if heldIn s.P src y.holder then
        { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y) := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact ⟨transfer_skel s src dst, fun b y hy => by rw [transfer_A_get, hy]; rfl⟩

/-- Ownership moves with the value (A5; J1): every place owned by the source or one of its parts is
now owned by the corresponding part of the destination, and keeps its parent (it does not move). -/
theorem transfer_moves_ownership {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place), s.P[q]? = some pl →
      s'.P[q]? = some (if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then
        { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl) := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact fun q pl hq => by rw [transfer_P_get, hq]; rfl

/-- J1: after an accepted transfer, an authority held by a part `r` of the source is held by the
corresponding part of the destination, which exists and is a part of `dst`; so is a place owned by
`r`, whose root, held by `r` (`RootHeld`), follows with it. -/
theorem transfer_to_corresponding_parts {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) {r : Nat} (hr : partOf s.P r src) :
    ∃ r', corr s.P src dst r = some r' ∧ partOf s.P r' dst ∧
      (∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[b]? = some y → y.holder = .place r →
        s'.A[b]? = some { y with holder := .place r' }) ∧
      (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place r →
        s'.P[q]? = some { pl with owner := .place r' }) := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hsh := hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  have h1 := hsh.1 r (List.mem_range.2 hr.1) hr
  unfold OptP at h1; split at h1
  · rename_i r' hc
    refine ⟨r', hc, corr_partOf hwf hpre.2.2.1.lt (r + 1) r r' (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hc,
      fun b y hy hh => ?_, fun q pl hq ho => ?_⟩
    · rw [transfer_A_get, hy]; simp [hh, heldIn, hr, mvTo, hc]
    · rw [transfer_P_get, hq]; simp [ho, heldIn, hr, mvTo, hc]
  · exact h1.elim

/-- `transfer_invalidates_source` (MM-03.3 §3, O4; §2, I4): after a transfer, every leaf of the
source is `Moved` and readable by no authority. -/
theorem transfer_invalidates_source {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s'.I l = .moved ∧ ∀ a, ¬ CanReadLeaf s' a l := by
  obtain ⟨⟨-, -, -, -, hov, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro l hl
  have hm : (transferEff s src dst).I l = .moved := by
    simp only [transferEff, show l ∉ footprint s.P dst from fun h' => hov ⟨l, hl, h'⟩, hl,
      ↓reduceIte]
  exact ⟨hm, fun a => i4_always _ a l hm⟩

/-- Moved dependencies (MM-03.3.6; MM-03.3 §3, O4): those of the source go with the destination
and leave the source and its parts. -/
theorem transfer_moves_deps {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
    (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, x ∈ s'.D dst) ∧ ∀ r, r ≠ dst → partOf s.P r src → s'.D r = [] := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact ⟨fun x hx => by simp [transferEff, hx], fun r hr hp => by simp [transferEff, hr, hp]⟩

/-- F5: an accepted `transfer` has disjoint footprints of source and destination. The clause is
the explicit precondition `¬ overlap s.P src dst` of `TransferPre`. -/
theorem transfer_footprints_disjoint {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, l ∉ footprint s.P dst :=
  fun l hl hl' => (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.2.2.2.2.1 ⟨l, hl, hl'⟩

/-- F5: the clause `¬ overlap s.P src dst` of `TransferPre` is redundant: it follows from clause 1
(source initialised) and clause 2 (destination without an `Init` leaf). It stays explicit (F5:
nothing removed). -/
theorem transfer_overlap_redundant {s : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h1 : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init)
    (h2 : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) : ¬ overlap s.P src dst :=
  fun ⟨l, hl, hl'⟩ => h2 l hl' (h1 l hl)

/-! ## Preservation by `depend`, `read3`, `write3` -/

theorem WF3.of_eq {s s' : S3} (h : WF3 s) (hA : s'.A = s.A) (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F)
    (hn : s'.nF = s.nF) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead) : WF3 s' := by
  obtain ⟨w0, w2, wne, wnd, wfr, wof, wop, wpa, wpo, wrc, wrh⟩ := h
  refine ⟨hA ▸ w0, by rw [hA, hP]; exact w2, hF ▸ wne, hF ▸ wnd, by rw [hF, hn]; exact wfr,
    by rw [hP, hn]; exact wof, by rw [hP]; exact wop, by rw [hP, hd]; exact wpa, ?_,
    wrc.transport (by rw [hP]) (by rw [hP])
      (fun a => by unfold S3.ancs; congr 1; funext i; simp only [S3.org, hA])
      (fun a y' h => ⟨y', hA ▸ h, rfl⟩)
      (fun x z h hz => ⟨z, hA ▸ h, hz, rfl⟩),
    wrh.transport hP fun x z h' hz => ⟨z, hA ▸ h', hz, rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  intro a y hy ya
  rw [hA] at hy; rw [HolderLive.congr hP hF hd]; exact wpo a y hy ya

/-- `depend` preserves `WF3` and `Inv3base` (MM-03.3 §3, O5; §10). -/
theorem depend_preserves {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s)
    (h : DependStep q x s (.ok s')) : WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' := by
  obtain ⟨⟨-, hx, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩ := hinv
  refine ⟨hwf.of_eq rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl, i1, i2, fun r hr y hy => ?_, i4_always _⟩
  have hr' := (S3.Usable.congr (s := s) (s' := dependEff s q x) rfl rfl rfl).1 hr
  simp only [dependEff] at hy
  split at hy
  · subst_vars; rcases List.mem_append.1 hy with hy | hy
    · exact i3 _ hr' y hy
    · simp at hy; exact hy ▸ hx
  · exact i3 r hr' y hy

/-- `depend_preserves_anchor_validity` (MM-03.3 §3, O5; §2, I3; §10): I3 is preserved and the
validity of every anchor is unchanged; `depend` lengthens the validity of no origin. -/
theorem depend_preserves_anchor_validity {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} (hi3 : I3 s)
    (h : DependStep q x s (.ok s')) : I3 s' ∧ ∀ y, s'.Active y ↔ s.Active y := by
  obtain ⟨⟨-, hx, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  refine ⟨fun r hr y hy => ?_, fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
  have hr' := (S3.Usable.congr (s := s) (s' := dependEff s q x) rfl rfl rfl).1 hr
  simp only [dependEff] at hy
  split at hy
  · subst_vars; rcases List.mem_append.1 hy with hy | hy
    · exact hi3 _ hr' y hy
    · simp at hy; exact hy ▸ hx
  · exact hi3 r hr' y hy

/-! ## Preservation by `store` (F4) -/

theorem storeEff_eq {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) :
    storeEff s a p = { s with
      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
      I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l } := by
  simp [storeEff, hy]

/-- `store` only changes the holder of `a` among the authorities (F4). -/
theorem store_skel (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : SameSkel s (storeEff s a p) := by
  cases hy : s.A[a]? with
  | none => unfold storeEff; rw [hy]; exact ⟨rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
  | some y =>
    rw [storeEff_eq hy]
    refine ⟨by simp, fun j => ?_⟩
    show ((s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p })[j]?).map skel = _
    rw [set_get (lt_of_getElem? hy)]; split
    · subst_vars; simp [hy, skel]
    · rfl

theorem store_get {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (j : Nat) :
    (storeEff s a p).A[j]? = if a = j then some { y with holder := .place p } else s.A[j]? := by
  rw [storeEff_eq hy]; exact set_get (lt_of_getElem? hy)

theorem store_pre_auth {s : S3} {a : Nat}
    (h : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top) False) :
    ∃ y, s.A[a]? = some y ∧ y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top := by
  have h1 := h; unfold OptP at h1
  split at h1
  · exact ⟨_, ‹_›, h1⟩
  · exact h1.elim

/-- `store` preserves `WF3` and `Inv3base` (F4): it changes the holder of a derived authority to a
usable place, adds an active anchor, and writes leaves. `RootHeld` is untouched: `a` is derived. -/
theorem store_preserves {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s)
    (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) : WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, -⟩ := store_pre_auth hpre.1
  have hp := hpre.2.1
  have sk := store_skel s a p
  have e := storeEff_eq (p := p) hy
  have hP : (storeEff s a p).P = s.P := by rw [e]
  have hF : (storeEff s a p).F = s.F := by rw [e]
  have hd : (storeEff s a p).dead = s.dead := by rw [e]
  have hn : (storeEff s a p).nF = s.nF := by rw [e]
  obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩ := hinv
  refine ⟨⟨sk.origin hwf.origin, by rw [hP]; exact sk.fp hwf.fp, hF ▸ hwf.ne, hF ▸ hwf.nodup,
    by rw [hF, hn]; exact hwf.frames, by rw [hP, hn]; exact hwf.ownerFrame,
    by rw [hP]; exact hwf.ownerPlace, by rw [hP, hd]; exact hwf.parts, fun j z hz za => ?_,
    sk.rootChain hwf.rootChain (by rw [hP]) (by rw [hP]), ?_⟩, sk.i1 i1, sk.i2 i2,
    fun q hq x hx => ?_, i4_always _⟩
  · rw [store_get hy] at hz; split at hz
    · cases hz; exact (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).2 hp
    · rw [HolderLive.congr hP hF hd]; exact hwf.poss j z hz za
  · exact hwf.rootHeld.transport hP fun x z' hx ho' => by
      rw [store_get hy] at hx; split at hx
      · cases hx; exact absurd ho' ho
      · exact ⟨z', hx, ho', rfl, rfl⟩
  · have hq' := (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hq
    rw [e] at hx; simp only at hx
    split at hx
    · subst q; rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx | hx
      · exact sk.active.2 (i3 _ hq' x hx)
      · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hx]; exact sk.active.2 ⟨y, hy, ya⟩
    · exact sk.active.2 (i3 q hq' x hx)

/-- `store` keeps the condition `EffAnchorOK` of every anchor (F4; C1): the effective anchor has
no origin (`effAnchor_root`) and `a` has one, so its holder does not change. -/
theorem store_effAnchorOK {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {y : Authority} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ho : y.origin ≠ none) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) :
    EffAnchorOK (storeEff s a p) x fd ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
  have sk := store_skel s a p
  have heq : (storeEff s a p).effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x := effAnchor_congr (by rw [sk.ancs])
  have hne : s.effAnchor x ≠ a := fun e => by
    have := effAnchor_root hwf.origin x; rw [e] at this
    simp only [S3.org, hy, Option.bind_some] at this; exact ho this
  have hA : (storeEff s a p).A[s.effAnchor x]? = s.A[s.effAnchor x]? := by
    rw [store_get hy]; simp [Ne.symm hne]
  have hP : (storeEff s a p).P = s.P := by rw [storeEff_eq hy]
  have hF : (storeEff s a p).F = s.F := by rw [storeEff_eq hy]
  unfold EffAnchorOK; rw [heq, hA, hF]
  simp only [S3.hframe_congr hP]

/-- `store` preserves `AnchorOrder` (F4; B8, C1): the added anchor satisfies the precondition on
its effective anchor; the other anchors and frames are unchanged. -/
theorem store_preserves_anchorOrder {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hao : AnchorOrder s)
    (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -, ho, -⟩ := store_pre_auth hpre.1
  have e := storeEff_eq (p := p) hy
  have hP : (storeEff s a p).P = s.P := by rw [e]
  have hF : (storeEff s a p).F = s.F := by rw [e]
  have hd : (storeEff s a p).dead = s.dead := by rw [e]
  intro q hq x hx
  have hq' := (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hq
  rw [store_effAnchorOK hwf hy ho, S3.pframe_congr hP]
  rw [e] at hx; simp only at hx
  split at hx
  · subst q; rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx | hx
    · exact hao _ hq' x hx
    · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hx]; exact hpre.2.2.2.2.1
  · exact hao q hq' x hx

/-- `store` preserves `NoDangling` (F4; C2): footprints, activity and usability are unchanged. -/
theorem store_preserves_noDangling {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (hnd : NoDangling s)
    (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) : NoDangling s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := store_pre_auth hpre.1
  have e := storeEff_eq (p := p) hy
  have hP : (storeEff s a p).P = s.P := by rw [e]
  have hF : (storeEff s a p).F = s.F := by rw [e]
  have hd : (storeEff s a p).dead = s.dead := by rw [e]
  have sk := store_skel s a p
  exact hnd.of (fun q l hl => by rw [hP] at hl; exact hl)
    (fun q hq => (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).2 hq)
    (fun j z hz za l hl => by
      obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, ez⟩ := sk.get hz; simp [skel] at ez
      exact ⟨j, z₀, hz₀, ez.2.2.2 ▸ za, ez.2.2.1 ▸ hl⟩)

/-- `store_root_rejected` (F4): storing an authority without origin, a root, is rejected. -/
theorem store_root_rejected {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[a]? = some y)
    (ho : y.origin = none) : StoreStep a p s .reject :=
  .reject fun h => by
    obtain ⟨y', hy', -, ho', -⟩ := store_pre_auth h.1
    rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'; exact ho' ho

/-- `store_keeps_target_reachable` (G2): after an `ok` store, the target leaf `p` is still
exercisable at `Modify` by the current frame. -/
theorem store_keeps_target_reachable {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) :
    HasRight s' .modify p := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1

/-- `store` writes one leaf (G2): the target `p` is a leaf, and it is the only leaf whose
initialisation changes, becoming `Init`. -/
theorem store_writes_one_leaf {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) :
    isLeaf s.P p ∧ s'.I p = .init ∧ ∀ l, l ≠ p → s'.I l = s.I l := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := store_pre_auth hpre.1
  rw [storeEff_eq hy]
  exact ⟨hpre.2.2.2.2.2.1, by simp, fun l hl => by simp [hl]⟩

/-- `store` into a leaf that holds an active authority is rejected (G2). -/
theorem store_occupied_rejected {s : S3} {a p j : Nat} {z : Authority} (hz : s.A[j]? = some z)
    (za : z.active = true) (hzp : z.holder = .place p) : StoreStep a p s .reject :=
  .reject fun h => by
    have := h.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hz))
    simp only [OptP, hz] at this
    exact this za hzp

/-- `store` into a place with parts, such as a whole structure, is rejected (G2). -/
theorem store_nonleaf_rejected {s : S3} {a p r : Nat} (hr : r < s.P.length)
    (hpr : parentOf s.P r = some p) : StoreStep a p s .reject :=
  .reject fun h => h.2.2.2.2.2.1 r hr hpr

theorem mem_of_mem_dropWhile {p : Nat → Bool} : ∀ {l : List Nat} {x : Nat}, x ∈ l.dropWhile p → x ∈ l
  | [], _, h => by simp at h
  | b :: l, x, h => by
    simp only [List.dropWhile_cons] at h
    split at h
    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (mem_of_mem_dropWhile h)
    · exact h

/-- `anchor_escape_rejected_at_transfer`, the pass-6 statement of `store_escape_rejected_at_transfer`,
kept on the anchors (F4; MM-03.3.1: « Un accès temporaire ne peut être
prolongé simplement en le stockant dans un cadre plus ancien »; MM-03.3.6; C1): a value `src`,
one of whose parts (`src` included) is anchored on an authority `a` whose effective anchor does
not move with the value and is of the current frame `f`, such as an authority derived from a
local of `f` and stored into `src` or one of its fields, cannot be transferred to a destination
whose frame, after the transfer, is an older frame `g`: the dependency follows the value
(`depsOf`, MM-03.3.6; MM-03.3 §3, O4) and the clause B8 of `transfer` checks its effective
anchor. An effective anchor that moves with the value, the root of storage the value owns,
travels with it (A5). The theorem speaks of the authorities placed by `store`, which anchors
them; a block issued to `src` is held without being an anchor (pass-6 report, (d) 3). -/
theorem anchor_escape_rejected_at_transfer {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst a f g : Nat} {F₀ : Frames}
    {z : Authority} (hwf : WF3 s) (hF : s.F = f :: F₀) (ha : a ∈ depsOf s src)
    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor a]? = some z) (hm : ¬ AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor a))
    (hzf : s.hframe z.holder = some f)
    (hg : (transferEff s src dst).pframe dst = some g) (hgF : g ∈ F₀) :
    TransferStep k src dst s .reject := by
  refine .reject fun hpre => ?_
  have hdst : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst := hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hin : a ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D dst := by
    simp only [transferEff, ↓reduceIte]
    exact List.mem_append_right _ ha
  have hok := hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 dst
    (List.mem_range.2 (by have := hdst.lt; simpa [transferEff] using this)) hdst a hin (.inr (.inl rfl))
  rw [transfer_effAnchorOK_unmoved hz hm, hg] at hok
  unfold EffAnchorOK at hok
  rw [hz] at hok
  simp only [OptP, hzf] at hok
  have hnd := List.nodup_cons.1 (hF ▸ hwf.nodup)
  rw [hF] at hok
  unfold ancestor at hok
  have hfg : f ≠ g := fun e => hnd.1 (e ▸ hgF)
  simp only [List.dropWhile_cons, show (f != g) = true by simp [hfg], ↓reduceIte] at hok
  exact hnd.1 (mem_of_mem_dropWhile hok)

/-- `store_escape_rejected_at_transfer` (F4, restated on the holder by G4; MM-03.3.1: « Un accès
temporaire ne peut être prolongé simplement en le stockant dans un cadre plus ancien »; C1): a
value `src`, one of whose parts (`src` included) holds an active authority `a` whose effective
anchor does not move with the value and is of the current frame `f`, cannot be transferred to a
destination whose frame, after the transfer, is an older frame `g`: the authority follows the
value (A4) and G4 checks its effective anchor in the arrival state. No restriction to `store`:
the authority may have been placed by `store`, `issue` or an earlier `transfer`. -/
theorem store_escape_rejected_at_transfer {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst a f g : Nat} {F₀ : Frames}
    {y z : Authority} (hwf : WF3 s) (hF : s.F = f :: F₀) (ha : s.A[a]? = some y)
    (ya : y.active = true) (hh : heldIn s.P src y.holder)
    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor a]? = some z) (hm : ¬ AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor a))
    (hzf : s.hframe z.holder = some f)
    (hg : (transferEff s src dst).pframe dst = some g) (hgF : g ∈ F₀) :
    TransferStep k src dst s .reject := by
  refine .reject fun hpre => ?_
  have hdst : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst := hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  obtain ⟨r', e, hr'⟩ := mvTo_part hwf hpre.2.2.1.lt hh
  have ha' : (transferEff s src dst).A[a]? = some { y with holder := .place r' } := by
    rw [transfer_A_get, ha]; simp [hh, e]
  have hok := hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 r' (transfer_usable_part hwf hr' hdst) a _ ha' ya rfl
  rw [transfer_pframe_part hwf hr', transfer_effAnchorOK_unmoved hz hm, hg] at hok
  unfold EffAnchorOK at hok
  rw [hz] at hok
  simp only [OptP, hzf] at hok
  have hnd := List.nodup_cons.1 (hF ▸ hwf.nodup)
  rw [hF] at hok
  unfold ancestor at hok
  have hfg : f ≠ g := fun e => hnd.1 (e ▸ hgF)
  simp only [List.dropWhile_cons, show (f != g) = true by simp [hfg], ↓reduceIte] at hok
  exact hnd.1 (mem_of_mem_dropWhile hok)

/-! ## Absence of orphan authorities (G3) -/

/-- G3, one link of a chain of holders: `a` is an active authority that covers the place holding
`b`, every leaf of that place being in the footprint of `a`. -/
def CoversHolder (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ s.afp a
    | .frame _ => False) False

/-- One `ok` transition of a kernel operation (MM-03.3 §3–5; A6–A9; F4). -/
inductive KStep (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
  | derive {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} : DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :

  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : DependStep q x s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} :
      EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | exit {s s' : S3} : ExitStep k s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : PinStep p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | unpin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : UnpinStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | endUse {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | free {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | alloc {s s' : S3} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} :
      AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | store {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} : StoreStep a p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'

/-- Sufficient conditions for the arena invariant to carry over to a new state: existing
authorities keep mode and footprint, only lose activity, keep an origin equal to `internal`; places
are not removed; `internal` stays held by a place (F1). -/
theorem arenaInv_transport {s s' : S3} {ar : Arena} (hai : ArenaInv s ar)
    (hA : ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → ∃ y', s'.A[j]? = some y' ∧
      y'.mode = y.mode ∧ y'.footprint = y.footprint ∧ (y'.active = true → y.active = true) ∧
      (y.origin = some ar.internal → y'.origin = some ar.internal))
    (hlen : s.P.length ≤ s'.P.length)
    (hown : ∀ (y y' : Authority) (v : Nat), s.A[ar.internal]? = some y →
      s'.A[ar.internal]? = some y' → y.holder = .place v → ∃ v', y'.holder = .place v')

    ArenaInv s' ar := by

  obtain ⟨yi', hyi', mi, fi, -, -⟩ := hA _ yi hyi
  have hafp : s'.afp ar.internal = s.afp ar.internal := by simp [S3.afp, hyi, hyi', fi]
  have act : ∀ x, s'.Active x → x < s.A.length → s.Active x := fun x ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ hx => by
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y := ⟨_, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.2 ⟨hx, rfl⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨y'', hy'', -, -, ha, -⟩ := hA x y hy
    rw [hy'] at hy''; cases hy''; exact ⟨y, hy, ha ya'⟩
  have old : ∀ e ∈ ar.issued, e.2 < s.A.length := fun e he => by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := c4 e he; exact lt_of_getElem? hy
  obtain ⟨vi', hh'⟩ := hown yi yi' vi hyi hyi' hhi
  refine ⟨fun l hl => hafp ▸ c0 l hl, fun e he l hl => hafp ▸ c1 e he l hl,
    c2.imp_of_mem fun {e e'} he he' h ha ha' => h (act _ ha (old e he)) (act _ ha' (old e' he')),
    fun e he ha => c3 e he (act _ ha (old e he)), fun e he => ?_, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le c5 hlen,
    ⟨yi', vi', hyi', mi ▸ hmi, hh'⟩, fun l => by rw [hafp, hfoot]; exact c7 l⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ho, hf, hm⟩ := c4 e he
  obtain ⟨y', hy', m', f', -, o'⟩ := hA _ y hy
  exact ⟨y', hy', o' ho, f'.trans hf, m'.trans hm⟩

/-- Determinism of `derive` (MM-03.3 §3, O1). -/
theorem derive_det {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3}
    (h₁ : DeriveStep src q m s o₁) (h₂ : DeriveStep src q m s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-- `ok` outcome of `derive` (MM-03.3 §3, O1). -/
theorem derive_ok_iff {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} {s s' : S3} :
    DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s') ↔ DerivePre s src q m ∧ s' = deriveEff s src q m := Guarded.ok_iff

/-- Determinism of `split` (MM-03.3 §3, O2). -/

    ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') ↔ ReleasePre s a ∧ s' = releaseEff s a := Guarded.ok_iff

/-- Determinism of `transfer` (MM-03.3 §3, O4). -/

theorem depend_ok_iff {q x : Nat} {s s' : S3} :

theorem enter_det {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3}

/-- `release_restores_authority` (MM-03.3 §3, O3; §10): if `b`, derived from `a`, is the only
active descendant of `a` covering `p`, then after `release b` the effective authority of `a` on
`p` is its mode; before, if `b` is in `Modify` on `p`, it was absent. -/
theorem release_restores_authority {s s' : S3} {b a p : Nat} {y x : Authority} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (h : ReleaseStep b s (.ok s')) (hy : s.A[b]? = some y) (ho : y.origin = some a)
    (hx : s.A[a]? = some x) (xa : x.active = true) (xp : p ∈ x.footprint)
    (honly : ∀ j z, s.A[j]? = some z → z.active = true → p ∈ z.footprint → a ∈ s.ancs j → j = b) :
    (y.mode = .modify → p ∈ y.footprint → effective s a p = none) ∧
    effective s' a p = some x.mode := by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨y', hy', ya⟩, -, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'
  have hab : a < b := hwf.origin b y a hy ho
  have hanc : a ∈ s.ancs b := by
    unfold S3.ancs; rw [chain_cons (by simp [S3.org, hy, ho]) hab]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
  refine ⟨fun hm hp => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [effective_eq hx xa xp]
    have : Mode.modify ∈ descModes s a p := mem_descModes.2 ⟨b, y, hy, ya, hp, hanc, hm⟩
    unfold effOf; simp only [List.ne_nil_of_mem this, this, ↓reduceIte]
  · have hb := lt_of_getElem? hy
    have hx' : (releaseEff s b).A[a]? = some x := by
